_comment: Paystack addon 1.0.0 (doc: wpforms.com/docs/paystack-addon/). Site prep: addon active, currency KES, Sullie payments mode=test, form 2552 Cake Order Form, payments 230/231 completed + 232 refunded. Restore currency MXN + addon off after.

variants.shows: WPForms > Settings > Payments with Paystack connected in Test Mode: currency Kenyan Shilling, Paystack section with Test Mode ON, connection status, key fields (values blanked at capture), Enable Webhooks ON and the Webhooks Endpoint URL with copy button.

steps.eval: document.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(function(i){ if(/paystack/i.test(i.name||i.id||'') && /key/i.test(i.name||i.id||'')){ i.value=''; i.removeAttribute('value'); } }); var el=document.querySelector('[id*="paystack-heading"]'); if(el) el.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});

Form builder > Payments > Paystack for form 2552 with Enable Conditional Logic switched ON and the empty rule builder (Process / Don't process this payment if...).

WPForms > Payments in Test Data mode with three Paystack test payments for Cake Order Form (two Completed, one Refunded, KES).
